newsitem.title: USA: Sealright to sell Los Angeles operation.
newsitem.headline: Sealright to sell Los Angeles operation.

text.p: Sealright said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to sell its Los Angeles operation that manufactures plastic containers for dairy products to Polytainers Inc.
Sealright said it is selling the operation in order to focus on other products and markets.
The sale is subject to a final agreement, which the two companies expect to complete in late January, and other customary conditions.
Sealright said it plans to retain ownership of the operation's real estate and lease the plant to Polytainers.
Polytainers is based in Missouri and provides plastic packaging for the food and dairy industries.
